statement: AMD frames AI inference as one of the fastest-growing segments of the AI market and is building its portfolio around it.
why: A major vendor reallocating acquisitions toward inference is a read on where accelerator demand is shifting relative to training.

impact.mechanism: Vendor investment aimed at inference workloads indicates growing deployed inference volume, which sustains accelerator purchase demand beyond training buildouts.

evidence.excerpt: one of the fastest-growing segments of the AI market.
AMD is building a full-stack AI platform that gives customers the flexibility to deploy the right compute solutions for every AI workload.

confidence.basis: Primary source, but the growth claim is qualitative vendor characterisation with no volume or revenue figure attached.
